settings.title: AI
settings.intro: Turn the AI on for your agency and choose what it does for your team.
settings.notReady: The AI isn't set up on this server yet, so no suggestion can be made. Your platform's administrator adds the OpenRouter key.
settings.switchIntro: When it is on, a Suggest reply button appears in each chat for your staff, and the AI reads a lead's chat to guess how likely it is to book. The chat's last messages, the lead's trip details, the names of the trips you sell, your trip details and quick replies are sent to the AI service, which keeps nothing. First name only: never a phone number or email.
settings.on: Let the AI draft replies and guess how leads will go
settings.usage: {used} of {limit} AI calls used this month, by every AI feature.
settings.scoring: Let the AI score each lead
settings.scoringHint: After each message from a customer: its chance to book, a line on how the lead stands, the next step, and whether it looks fake. Shown on the lead's page.
settings.fillLeads: Let the AI fill in new WhatsApp leads
settings.fillLeadsHint: From a new customer's first messages: where, when, how many and the budget, put on the lead as suggestions in violet for your team to confirm. It never changes what a person already wrote. It uses the same AI call as scoring.
settings.writeStyle: Style of the message for the customer
settings.writeStyleHint: Used by "Write for the customer" on a quote. The AI never types a price: the total and the advance come from the quote.
settings.moved: The AI agent that answers WhatsApp has its own page: its setup, what needs you, and Try it.

suggest.nothing: The AI had no reply to suggest for this chat.
suggest.draftedHint: Read it, change it, then send.

knowledge.title: Your documents
knowledge.description: Brochures and notes about your packages, prices, inclusions and dates. Package drafts are written from these, below. The WhatsApp agent answers from your packages and your setup, not from these documents.
knowledge.upload: Upload a PDF or text file
knowledge.uploaded: Uploaded. The AI is reading it.
knowledge.fileType: Choose a PDF or a .txt file.
knowledge.empty: Nothing yet. Add your packages and prices: package drafts are written from them.
knowledge.removeDescription: Package drafts won't use it any more, and a document's file is deleted.
knowledge.dialogDescription: Write the package as you would tell a new salesperson: what's included, the price and its basis. Package drafts are written from it.
knowledge.bodyPlaceholder: Kerala 5N/6D: Munnar 2N, Thekkady 1N, Alleppey houseboat 1N, Kovalam 1N. ₹18,500 per person on twin sharing, hotels, breakfast, cab and sightseeing included. Flights extra.

stageSuggestion.title: The AI suggests marking this lead {stage}

insight.title: AI's guess
insight.info: The AI's reading of this lead from its chat: how likely it books in the next two weeks, why, and what to do next. A guess to help you choose who to call first, never a decision: it never changes the lead's stage.
insight.fakeHint: Spam, a test or a wrong number, by the AI's reading.

chat.title: The AI in this chat
chat.notAnswering: The AI doesn't answer this chat.
chat.agentOff: The AI agent is off, so it answers no chat.
chat.agentNotReady: The AI agent isn't set up yet, so it answers no chat.
chat.queued: The AI has the message and is waiting for the next line.
chat.thinking: The AI is writing a reply.

chat.barFlagged: {name} flagged: {reason}. It's still answering; join any time.
chat.barPaused: You wrote in this chat, so {name} waits until {until} so you two don't answer at once.

test.title: Try it
test.description: Write as a customer would and keep the chat going, to see what the AI agent would answer from your packages and setup. Nothing is sent, but each answer uses some of this month's AI calls.
test.placeholder: Kerala ka 5 din ka package kitne ka hai?

choices.onlyFlash: Only Gemini Flash takes a temperature.
choices.thisChatOnly: The model and temperature apply only to this test chat, never to your customers' chats.

test.handoff: It would hand the chat to your team: {reason}

actions.files: It would send the package's brochure.
actions.book: It would send the payment details and take the booking.
actions.note: It would add a note to the lead.
actions.task: It would add a follow-up for your team.

test.blocked: Nothing would be sent: {reason}. Your team would be told.

sheet.description: Say it, type it, paste a message or show a screenshot. You check everything before it is saved.

draft.title: Draft the days
draft.description: The AI writes the day-by-day plan from the lead, your packages and what your agency knows. A note is optional. You check everything before it is saved.
draft.textHint: For example: relaxed, no long drives, one day free. Type or speak.
draft.removedAmounts: The AI typed an amount of its own and it was taken out. Check the days read right.

writeUp.title: Write for the customer
writeUp.description: The AI writes a message about this quote from its plan, inclusions and notes. The total and the advance are the quote's own. Nothing is sent.
writeUp.reviewDescription: Read it, change what you like, then copy it or put it in the customer's chat box. Nothing is sent from here.
writeUp.channelHint: WhatsApp is short with a few emojis. Email has a greeting, sections and a sign-off, and is copied: the product sends no email to customers.
writeUp.textHint: {used} of {limit} AI calls used this month.
writeUp.stale: The quote changed. Write again, so the message matches it.
writeUp.removedAmounts: The AI typed an amount of its own and it was taken out. Check the message reads right: only the quote's total and advance are filled in.
writeUp.noDays: Add the day-by-day plan to the quote first, so the AI has something to write about.
writeUp.noChat: This customer has no chat you can use here, so copy the message instead.

rooming.title: Read room requests
rooming.description: The AI reads each traveller's room note, the notes on their booking's lead and what it kept from the chat, and proposes which travellers asked for a single room, the ground floor or to be near the group. Nothing changes until you apply. This uses one AI call.
rooming.reviewDescription: Tick the requests to set. The rooms are still drafted by Draft rooms.
rooming.applied: {count, plural, one {# request set} other {# requests set}}
rooming.nothing: The AI found no clear room request in the notes. Travellers who already have a request are left as they are.

seats.title: Find interested people
seats.description: People who asked about this place in the last year and could be offered the empty seats. Nobody who is blocked, asked to stop or was offered this departure in the last 14 days is listed.
seats.messagesDescription: One message for each person. Read it, change it, then open it in your own WhatsApp and send it from there. Nothing is sent by the product.
seats.choose: Tick up to {max} people to write to.
seats.more: More people qualify than are shown here.
seats.write: {count, plural, =0 {Write messages} one {Write # message} other {Write # messages}}
